query:
INSERT INTO detection_segments (
                id,
                episode_id,
                start_time,
                end_time,
                text,
                ad_score,
                is_ad
            )
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

            ON CONFLICT(episode_id, start_time, end_time)
            DO UPDATE SET
                text = excluded.text,
                ad_score = excluded.ad_score,
                is_ad = excluded.is_ad
